title: The Work of His Hands
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Isaiah prayed a gentle prayer
And found the words to say:
"O Lord, You are our Father, so
We rest here as Your clay."

[Chorus]
We are the clay in His kind hands,
He shapes us, slow and true;
We're not yet done, but we are loved,
He's making something new.

[Verse 2]
A bowl can't shape itself, you know,
It rests and waits a while;
The potter's thumbs press soft and slow,
And then he starts to smile.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Wren's playdough snake kept breaking up,
Her hands went still and tight;
But Grandpa rolled his slow and soft,
And then hers came out right.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So every finger, every thought,
Came out of hands that care;
He's not done making me just yet,
I'm clay, and He is there.

[Chorus]
mood: Shaping music. A slow, round turning under the voice, even all the way through, like a wheel going round under two patient thumbs. Soft felt piano, one chord at a time, each one placed and left to ring before the next, a low warm hum underneath. Nothing hurries and nothing swells. It ends settled and glad, a finished bowl set out in the midday sun.
